Customer Support Analyst
Copperline Finance | Remote | Full time

About the role
You will help customers and feed what you learn back to the product team.

What we are looking for
- 0-2 years of experience.
- Patient troubleshooting of customer problems.
- Excellent written English.
- A ticketing tool such as Zendesk.
- Willingness to work rotating shifts.

Nice to have
- A second language.

Visa sponsorship is available for the right candidate.

We offer a learning budget, a quiet office with good coffee, flexible hours on most days, a yearly team trip, and a generous leave policy. We care about how you work with others and how you grow, and we review pay fairly twice a year.
